When trying to file emails, there's an error when opening outlook or filing an email. A window will open with a mini interface of iManage with no option to file.

The solution appears to be a missing Reg Key.

- Open 'Registry Editor' and go to the following file path:

HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\iManage\Work\10.0\Client\login\

![[Pasted image 20241231130632.png]]

Where the list of keys are, right click on some empty space and create a 'DWORD' Key.

![[Pasted image 20241231130702.png]]

- The name should be **AllowOAuth2** and the value should be 1

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Restart the IManage service in the system tray (possibly a machine reboot) and restart outlook.
